verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly support reviewing code in the IDE before pushing. They describe instant feedback in VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf and other VS Code-based IDEs, review of uncommitted changes as you code with instant fixes, and pricing lists agentic reviews across PR, CLI and IDE. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the IDE review applies the same configuration and learnings as the PR review (the 'same review' parity is only implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the IDE extension.
